test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The average of Kanchan's marks in 7 subjects is 75. Her average in six subjects excluding Science is 72. How many marks did she get in Science?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Average marks** of 7 subjects = 75

**Average marks** of 6 subjects = 72 (Decrease of 3 marks)

**Science marks** = Original Average + (Total subjects × Decrease in Average)

**Science marks** = 75 + (6 × 3) = 75 + 18 = 93

**∴ The correct answer is 93.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of subjects (n₁) = 7, Average (A₁) = 75

Number of subjects excluding Science (n₂) = 6, Average (A₂) = 72

**Formula Used:**

Total Marks = Average × Number of subjects

Marks in excluded subject = Total marks of all subjects − Total marks of remaining subjects

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f098c3c5be0fdd01bdb17e7f13912a16ba55e0440b6e146fccb0ba58aef02b1.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total marks in 7 subjects = 7 × 75 = 525

⇒ Total marks in 6 subjects = 6 × 72 = 432

⇒ Marks in Science = 525 − 432

⇒ Marks in Science = 93

**∴ The correct answer is 93.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Definition

Average is the sum of all observations divided by the total number of observations. Average = Sum ÷ Count.

Deviation Method

The sum of deviations of all items from their arithmetic mean is always zero. This can be used to find a missing value quickly.

Inclusion/Exclusion Rule

Value of excluded item = Old Sum − New Sum = (Old Count × Old Average) − (New Count × New Average).</p
